definitions.gloss: ancient document; historical document; old manuscript
definitions.explanation: Official or private documents from past eras, preserved as historical records. Includes letters, decrees, contracts, and other written materials from pre-modern Japan.

notes:
{古文書|こもんじょ} refers to official or private documents from past eras, preserved as historical records. Includes letters, decrees, contracts, and other written materials from pre-modern Japan.

PRONUNCIATION:
The standard reading is こもんじょ. The alternative reading こぶんしょ exists but refers more broadly to old writings or classical texts in general.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古文書|こもんじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解読|かいどく}→解読：14185_kaidoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to decipher ancient documents
- {古文書|こもんじょ}⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧: paleography, study of ancient documents
- {古文書|こもんじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: survey of historical documents
- {古文書|こもんじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to preserve historical documents

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧: classics, classical literature
- ⟦{文献|ぶんけん}→文献：12885_bunken⟧: written source, reference document
- ⟦{史料|しりょう}→史料：20753_shiryou⟧: historical source material

USAGE:
Primarily an academic term used in history, archival science, and museum contexts. Reading {古文書|こもんじょ} requires specialized training in {崩|くず}し{字|じ} (cursive script) since pre-modern documents use different writing conventions.
